centered_shell_family.role: fixed initial family for the R056 locality-barrier question; not a teacher target

energy.post_acceptance_checker: After every accepted move recompute S, centroid g, and full exact G from the complete N-cell state; incremental formulas may only be scoring/checking accelerators.

move_class.D_1_1_relation: D(1,1) contains the original R055 D1 nearest-neighbor single-cell slide subject to the same final topology conditions.
move_class.R055_D2_relation: R055 D2 can use relocation span growing with the shell and is not any one fixed D(m,rho) family as r->infinity.
admissibility_order: U and V are finite sets with U subset C and V subset Lambda\C
C_prime has exactly N occupied lattice sites
C_prime is hole-free under the frozen R055 topology convention
recompute exact full centroid and G
move_class.cooperative_interpretation: For m>1 this is a cooperative bounded-support rearrangement reference; it is not automatically a physically realizable slide law.
move_class.fixed_locality_quantifier: When claiming fixed bounded locality, m and rho are fixed independently of shell radius r.
move_class.name: D(m,rho)
move_class.support_diameter: diam_L(U union V)=max_{x,y in U union V} d_L(x,y)
move_class.support_semantics: Diameter is computed on all changed sites pairwise; it is not a path length, bounding-box surrogate, source-destination-only span, or Euclidean diameter.

r055_read_only_evidence.d2_interpretation: R055 D2 is a nonlocal relocation reference. It is not relabeled as local and is not identified with any fixed D(m,rho) family as r grows.
r055_read_only_evidence.immutability: READ_ONLY; no R055 byte may be modified, consumed as writable state, or re-frozen under R056

semantic_typing.circle_pi_circumference_tangent_teacher_: N3/teacher-side objects forbidden from move selection and locality selection
semantic_typing.native_claim_policy: R056 makes no claim that the axial carrier, Q, graph distance, centroid, or quadratic gravity energy is N0-native.

state_space.connected: all occupied sites form one component under the six nearest-neighbor directions
state_space.hole_free: Use the frozen R055 topology convention: within the axial bounding box of C padded by 1 in each coordinate, flood-fill empty sites from every empty site on the padded-box boundary using the same six-neighbor adjacency. C is hole-free iff every empty site in the unpadded bounding box is exterior-reachable.
